text: {"lessons":["My account ended only modestly above its initial value, so I should judge decisions by long-run portfolio results, not a few winning trades or short-term account swings.","I sold Stock C and D at substantial losses, then rotated among other stocks; I should avoid switching holdings without a stronger, forward-looking reason than recent price moves.","My Stock A trades turned a brief holding into a loss, so I should plan position size and exit conditions before buying and reassess them deliberately rather than reactively."]}
